text: Welcome to Monroe's vibrational state and roll out. Lie flat on your back if you can, and loosen anything tight. Let your eyes close. If buzzing or tingling comes later, that is expected. Stay calm and curious.
Dim the room and turn on the Ganzfeld light. Sit facing the screen, close your eyes, and let your gaze rest in the soft red glow.

Welcome to the imagined viewpoint exercise. Lie on your back with your eyes closed. This is pure imagination, with no hypnosis: you will picture your body from the outside, as if from a camera above you.

Welcome to the hypnotic out of body session. You remain in control throughout, and you can return at any time simply by opening your eyes. Lie back somewhere you will not be disturbed, and rest your gaze on a spot on the ceiling.
Welcome to Solfeggio 852 hertz, traditionally linked to intuition. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to the tone of Mercury, 141.27 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Tune in to high gamma, eighty hertz, as rapid isochronic pulses. Keep the volume comfortable and low. After this minute, the beat glides to 80 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to the forty hertz session. These are quick, even pulses of sound, the kind used in the GENUS studies. Keep the volume comfortable and low. Sit or lie back, and simply let the pulses run.
Go deeper with each breath out.
Bring your attention to a point about three finger widths below your navel, deep inside the belly. Feel warmth gathering there, like a small sun.
Sound: listen to the quiet sounds around you, and any sounds inside your head.
Welcome to the Schumann resonance, played as sound. Keep the volume low, and add the infrasound layer if you wish. Lie back, close your eyes, and let the slow 7.83 hertz rhythm settle under the tone.
Now let go of the technique completely, and drift off to sleep as quickly as you can. If you notice you are dreaming, stay calm, and remember: this is a dream.

Welcome to the Kox study protocol. Sit or lie down somewhere safe, never in or near water, and never while standing or driving. Press Breathwork and start the guide when you are ready. Rest your hands, and let your breathing settle.
Feel a steady golden warmth just above your navel.
Welcome to kinesthetic floating. Lie flat on your back, arms by your sides, eyes closed. In this session you will not picture anything. Instead, you will feel movement, as if from the inside.
Bright, integrated awareness.
Welcome to jhana practice. Sit upright, relaxed and still, and close your eyes. This practice builds concentration, then lets joy arise from it. Begin by feeling the breath at the tip of your nose.
Let the viewpoint float down and slip back behind your own eyes. Feel your body from the inside again. Breathe a little deeper, move your fingers, and open your eyes when you are ready.

Welcome to Soundless Music, the seventeen hertz experiment. Keep the volume low, and add the infrasound layer if you choose. Then close your eyes, and notice any change in mood, with curiosity rather than fear.
Restoration.
Feel the weight of your body supported by the earth beneath you.
Welcome to the crown chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at the top of your head.
Silently state, in your own words, what you wish to explore or learn in this session. Then let the words go.
Stand in that place, and feel the ground, the air and the sounds around you. Then begin to travel, walking, flying or gliding, across the landscape.
Welcome to Deep Restoration. Lie down where you can fall asleep, and keep the volume very low. Let your body sink into the bed. This long, slow session glides down into deep delta sleep.
Welcome to Schumann mode 3, 20.8 hertz: the third harmonic, brighter and faster. Sit comfortably and stay softly alert. After this minute, the beat glides into place and holds.
Welcome to dream yoga. Lie down in bed, on your side, with one hand under your cheek, in the posture of a sleeping lion. Keep the volume very low, and let your eyes close.
Let your attention widen to include everything at once: all the sounds, the whole body, the space of the room. Hold nothing in particular.
Welcome to the 432 hertz tuning. Sit back and close your eyes. Compare how this pitch feels with the 440 hertz session. A gentle eight hertz alpha beat rides on the tone.
Imagine a clear channel of light running through the centre of your body, from below your navel up to the crown of your head, open at the top like a skylight.
Set a short, positive intention, and repeat it silently three times.
Set an intention: a question, or simply an openness to whatever comes. Then let it go. If anything difficult arises in this session, remember three words: trust, let go, be open.

Welcome to Solfeggio 741 hertz, traditionally linked to expression and problem solving. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Sleep deeply.
Let the shimmer of each bowl ripple through your body.
Slowly, let the familiar world return: your body, your breath, the room. Bring back whatever was meaningful.

Welcome to cyclic sighing. Sit comfortably. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Breathe in through your nose, take one more short sip of air at the top, then let it all out slowly through your mouth.
Tune in to theta, five hertz, popularly linked to intuition and problem solving. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 5 hertz and holds there.
Tune in to alpha, eight hertz: relaxed, receptive learning. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 8 hertz and holds there.
The state of no time. Release the past and the future. There is only this open, still moment.
As the bowls grow quieter, follow the sound into silence, and keep listening.
Let the sacred word go. Remain in silence with your eyes closed for a couple of minutes, perhaps praying a familiar prayer slowly, before returning to your day.
Welcome to the chakra journey, from root to crown. Sit tall and close your eyes. We begin at the base of the spine. Feel your connection to the ground beneath you, stable and safe.
Rest in quiet, open awareness.
Now descend, slowly, the way you came: through the gold, through the violet, down into the dark, solid earth. Feel your body again.
Let the drum fade into the background. Follow whatever images, memories or sensations arise, as if on a journey.
Let the excitement of rapture fade into the background, and rest in a quieter, warm happiness.
Tune in to high gamma, sixty three hertz, as isochronic pulses. Keep the volume comfortable and low. After this minute, the beat glides to 63 hertz and holds there.
Hold your target in mind. Notice first impressions: shapes, colours, textures. Do not name them; just notice.
Welcome to Focus 27, the park. Lie back and let your eyes close. At the end of this journey you will create a peaceful place of your own. For now, let the tones begin to slow you down.
Rest in the glow, half awake, half dreaming.
Hover at the edge of sleep, where images begin to form.
Welcome to Focus 23, quiet reflection. Lie back, let your eyes close, and allow yourself to feel safe and held. This is a gentle session for memories and feelings. You can open your eyes at any time.
Now begin to rise, slowly, up the column of light. Pass through a veil of deep violet, cool and silvery, like moonlight on water.
With your eyes closed, see the symbol grow larger and larger, until it is a doorway in front of you, the size of a real door. When you are ready, step through it.
Sound and light now pulse together at ten hertz. Let them carry you.
Let your shoulders and jaw soften.
Let your voice fall quiet. Sit in the silence, and notice how you feel.

Tense the muscles of your feet for a moment, then let them go. Now your calves, then your thighs, your belly, your hands, your arms and shoulders, and finally your face. With each release, sink deeper.
Now let your whole body expand in every direction, like a balloon slowly filling with air, until you fill the whole room.
Let the boundary between you and the image soften. Let it come closer and dissolve into light, and let that light dissolve into you, until there is no observer and nothing observed.
The drum quickens. Thank your teacher, and come back the way you came, down through the membrane, down the tree, back into your body.

Welcome to Solfeggio 528 hertz, traditionally linked to transformation; it is often called the love frequency. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Let the warmth of gratitude spread through your whole body.
Begin to climb. Go higher and higher, past the treetops and the clouds, until you feel a thin, soft membrane above you. Push gently through it.
Let your body fall asleep while your mind stays awake.
Tune in to beta, twenty five hertz: high alertness. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 25 hertz and holds there.
Rest.
Breathe out longer than you breathe in. Let tension leave with each breath out.
Repeat silently: next time I am dreaming, I will remember that I am dreaming.
The drum calls you home. Travel back the way you came, to your starting place, and return into your body, bringing back what you found.
Picture a strong container with a heavy lid. Place every worry, task and distraction inside it, close the lid, and set it aside. You can return for them later.
Bring your attention to the task in front of you. Let the tone hold your focus steady.
Return now, and sketch whatever you noticed.
Welcome to Schumann mode 1, 7.83 hertz: the fundamental resonance between the Earth and the sky. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides into place and holds.
Tune in to gamma, thirty eight hertz, just below the classic forty. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 38 hertz and holds there.

Welcome to classical ratio breathing. Sit upright, with your hands resting on your knees. Press Breathwork to start the guide. The holds should feel comfortable; if they don't, choose the shorter preset.
Tune in to theta, six hertz: the meditation rhythm. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 6 hertz and holds there.

Welcome to the four seven eight breath. Sit with your back straight, and rest the tip of your tongue just behind your upper front teeth. Press Breathwork to start the guide: in for four, hold for seven, out for eight.
Welcome to the third eye session. Sit upright and comfortable, and let your eyes close. Let your breathing slow. Soon you will rest your attention lightly at the point between your eyebrows.

Welcome to the ten hertz light journey. Dim the room, sit facing the light, and close your eyes. When you are ready, press Light journey and accept the warnings. The flashes lock to the ten hertz beat.
One more time. Chime, awareness, and the thought: I am dreaming. Now lie back and let yourself drift off to sleep, keeping that intention lightly in mind.
From the ceiling, look around the room. Notice the furniture, the door, the window, the light. Then look down at your body again, resting peacefully.

Welcome to the Christos technique. Lie on your back with your eyes closed. If you have a partner, ask them to rub the soles of your feet and the centre of your forehead, firmly and gently. If not, simply rest, and imagine it.
Breathe slowly. Let the area of discomfort soften with each breath out.
Tune in to theta, 6.3 hertz, the rate popularly claimed for astral projection. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 6.3 hertz and holds there.
Eight hertz, rhythmic.
Let memories and feelings surface gently, and let them go with kindness.
Welcome to remote viewing practice. Have a pen and paper ready, and ask a friend to choose a hidden picture or place as your target. Then sit back, close your eyes, and cool down.

Notice the landscape on the other side: the light, the colours, the ground, the air. Explore gently, and let the scene unfold by itself. If you meet anyone, you may ask what this element has to teach.
Begin to speak, aloud or in a whisper, in your own language. Say what is on your mind today, however small. If no words come, repeat: Master of the World.
Welcome to gentle vase breathing. Sit upright and relaxed. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Breathe softly into the lower belly, and imagine warmth spreading through your whole body.
Tune in to gamma, thirty three hertz, at the low edge of gamma. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 33 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to the Schumann stack. All five resonance modes play at once, each on its own tone, like a chord from the sky. Lie back, close your eyes, and rest in the layered sound.

Welcome to the tone of the Earth year, the traditional tone of Om, 136.1 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to Tibetan visualisation meditation. Sit upright and still, and close your eyes. Choose one image to work with: a buddha, a deity, a mandala, or simply a sphere of clear light.
Welcome to meeting an inner guide. Sit or lie comfortably, and close your eyes. Bring to mind a question you would like help with, something that matters to you. Hold it gently.
Let go again, and see what else appears.
Now let the phrase continue silently, in the heart alone, with each bell and each breath.
Tune in to SMR, fourteen hertz: focused attention. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 14 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to the tone of Saturn, 147.85 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Lie down and let the sound of the bowls wash over you.
Observe the natural breath as it enters and leaves, just as it is. Feel its touch at the nostrils. Don't control it; simply observe.
Now count down slowly with me, and with each number drift twice as deep. Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one. Deeply, comfortably relaxed.
Welcome to SMR Calm Focus. Sit upright and bring your attention to the task in front of you. The beat settles at thirteen and a half hertz, the calm, steady focus rhythm. Breathe evenly, and begin.
Welcome to the target technique. Before you relax, choose a familiar room as your target, and picture it clearly for a moment. Now lie back, close your eyes, and let your breathing slow.
This is the hybrid demo: a binaural pair that is also pulsed. Headphones work best. Close your eyes and notice two things at once: the wobble between your ears, and the pulse within the tone.
Gently begin to return. Move your fingers and toes, and open your eyes when you are ready.
Rest now. Let your breathing return to its own natural rhythm, and notice how you feel. Stay sitting or lying down for a minute before you get up.
Welcome to the dry float. Make the room as dark and quiet as you can, and lie on your back on a soft surface, never in water. Let your arms rest loosely, palms up. Keep the volume low.
Welcome to the astral projection session. Lie flat on your back, arms by your sides, and let your eyes close. Let your breathing slow. First we relax the body completely. Then comes the rope.
Now fly back the way you came, above your house, through the front door, and into your body. Feel your weight again. Move your fingers and toes, and open your eyes when you are ready.
Welcome to Solfeggio 174 hertz, traditionally linked to foundation and grounding. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Hold a light object loosely in one hand. Bring to mind a problem you want to solve.
Welcome to Schumann mode 2, 14.3 hertz: the second harmonic of the Earth's resonance. Sit comfortably and stay softly alert. After this minute, the beat glides into place and holds.
Let that wish expand to include everyone, without exception.
Imagine you are sitting on a swing. Feel it carry you forward and back, in time with the sound. With each arc, swing a little higher, and feel the drop in your stomach at each end.
Welcome to phowa. Sit upright, with your spine straight and relaxed, and close your eyes. Breathe naturally. Bring to mind a feeling of compassion for yourself and for all beings.
Six hertz, theta.
Let your chest soften and open with kindness.
Tune in to hypergamma, one hundred hertz, a speculative band from popular sources. Keep the volume comfortable and low. After this minute, the beat glides to 100 hertz and holds there.
Sit upright and relaxed. Count your breaths from one to ten, then begin again.

Welcome to Om meditation. Sit upright, with your spine tall and relaxed, and let your eyes close. Take a few slow breaths. Soon you will chant, or silently hear, Om on each breath out, matched to the tone.
Ask your question, and listen. The answer may come as words, an image, a feeling, or a gift. Accept whatever comes, with thanks.
Now slow down. Sight: gently watch the darkness behind your eyelids, with no effort.
If you lose count, simply begin again at one.
Above your head, imagine a presence of pure light and kindness: a buddha, a saint, or simply radiant light. Feel welcomed by it.
Expanded awareness. Let your awareness spread beyond the edges of your body in every direction. Notice whatever arises, without effort.
Welcome to nondual awareness. Sit comfortably, eyes softly open or closed. There is nothing to achieve here. Simply notice that you are already aware: of sounds, of sensations, of this voice.
Now hold the whole image steady and vivid, in front of you or above your head. Rest your full attention on it.
The drum quickens. Gently return the way you came, and bring back what you found.
If nothing worked, that's normal. Let yourself drift back to sleep, holding the intention to try again the moment you next wake.
Let the phrase fall away. Sit in the silence it leaves, with your attention resting at your heart.
Welcome to the tone of Mars, 144.72 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.

Welcome to the psychomanteum. Dim the room to a single soft light behind you, and place a mirror so that you see only darkness in it, not your own face. Have photographs or keepsakes of the person you are remembering with you.
Bring to mind three things you are grateful for.

Welcome to the mystical experience arc. This session uses no substances, only stillness and sound. Lie down comfortably, and cover your eyes with a soft mask or cloth. Make sure you will not be disturbed for forty minutes.
Tune in to theta, four hertz: the threshold between waking and sleep. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 4 hertz and holds there.
In this calm state, your mind is open to helpful ideas. Each day you feel calmer, clearer, and more at ease. Stress passes through you, and leaves you steady.
Welcome to the third eye chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at the space between your eyebrows.
Bring to mind someone you love. Wish them well: may you be happy, may you be safe.
Stop. Breathe in deeply, stretch your arms up, and breathe out slowly. Rest in the silence.
Make a heartfelt intention: tonight, I will recognise my dreams as dreams. Repeat it silently a few times, then let the words go.

Welcome to Robert Bruce's rope technique. Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, and let your eyes close. The pulsing beats help you relax deeply first. Keep your mind awake as your body lets go.

Welcome to the cyclic breathing journey, inspired by Sudarshan Kriya. Sit upright, cross legged or on a chair, somewhere safe. Press Breathwork to start the guide; it leads you through each part, then asks you to lie down and rest.
Tune in to theta, 7.5 hertz: the creative border between alpha and theta. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 7.5 hertz and holds there.
Tune in to delta, one hertz: the slow rhythm of deep, dreamless sleep. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 1 hertz and holds there.
Intuition.
Build your image slowly and in detail: its shape, its colours, the light coming from it, every fine feature. If it fades, rebuild it patiently.
This is the monaural beats demo. The two tones are mixed before they reach you, so the beat is a real pulse in the air, and speakers work. Close your eyes and listen to the throb.
At the top of the next arc, let go, and keep rising, floating up and out, as if the swing has launched you gently into the air.
Tune in to 7.83 hertz, the Schumann resonance of the Earth. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 7.83 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to breath of fire. Sit upright, with your spine straight. Press Breathwork to start the guide. The breath is quick, light and even, in and out through the nose, pumped from the navel.
Keep watching that spot. Your eyelids grow heavier with each breath, heavier and heavier. When they want to close, let them close, and let a wave of comfort spread through you.

Welcome to Focus 21, the bridge. This is the longest Gateway session, so make sure you are warm and comfortable. Let your eyes close. We will move step by step, through Focus 10, 12 and 15, to the edge of the bridge.

Welcome to the constant light control. Sit or lie facing the light with your eyes closed, in a dark room. Start the light journey now. After one dark minute the light comes on and stays steady for twenty minutes, with no flicker at all.
Welcome to the shamanic journey. Lie down and cover your eyes. Set your intention for the journey: a question, or a place you wish to visit. Hold it simply, in a few words.
From the crown, let it flow down over your forehead, between your eyebrows, through the tongue, down the throat and the centre of your chest, back to the point below your navel.
Welcome to box breathing. Sit upright and relaxed. Press Breathwork to start the guide. It begins with a short test of how slowly you can breathe out, then sets the size of your box.
Whichever technique felt strongest, keep it going, then try to separate again: roll out, or float up.
Welcome to Ganzflicker, eyes closed. The light alternates between red and black, about ten times a second. Close your eyes, face the screen, and let the red glow fill your whole field of view.
Let a sense of reverence arise: for life, for this moment, for existence itself. Whatever is sacred to you, let it be near.

Welcome to alternate nostril breathing. Sit upright. Rest your left hand in your lap, and bring your right hand to your face: the thumb will close the right nostril, the ring finger the left. Press Breathwork to start the guide.

Welcome to audio visual entrainment. Close your eyes and face the light, and start the light journey. The sound pulses and the light flashes run at the same rate, starting at ten hertz and slowing gently toward deep relaxation.
Feel the earth beneath you, solid and dark, like rich soil. This is your starting point, and you can always return here.

Welcome to Focus 24 to 26, the belief system levels. Lie back and let your eyes close. This session invites you to look at your own beliefs with curiosity. First, let the tones carry you through the familiar levels.
Rise further still, toward a brilliant white light above. Go only as far as feels right. Notice what you sense here, without trying to hold on to it.
Welcome to Compassion Gamma. Sit comfortably, eyes closed, and rest a hand on your heart if you like. Let your breathing slow. Soon you will bring to mind someone you love.
Picture yourself having already reached your goal. See, hear and feel it in rich detail.
Rest in the stillness between the sounds.
Tune in to theta, 4.5 hertz: the rate of the shamanic drum. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 4.5 hertz and holds there.
This is the amplitude modulation demo. The tone swells and fades smoothly, like a slow tremolo, gentler than a pulse. Speakers are fine. Close your eyes and ride the waves of sound.
Eight hertz, the start of alpha.
Welcome to Focus 15, the state of no time. Lie back, loosen anything tight, and let your eyes close. After the preparation we pass through Focus 10 and 12 into deep stillness. Let go of the clock.

Welcome to inner fire breathing. Sit upright, cross legged or on a chair, somewhere safe and away from water. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Imagine a small flame, glowing just below your navel.
The bridge. Rest at the edge where deep stillness meets bright, high awareness. Observe without holding on.

Welcome to Focus 12, expanded awareness. Lie back and let your eyes close. After the preparation you will pass through Focus 10, then let your awareness widen beyond the edges of your body. For now, just listen.
Releasing fear and guilt.
When you notice you are engaged with any thought, feeling or image, return ever so gently to the sacred word. Then rest again in silence.
Turn your attention toward that feeling of I. Not your name or your story, just the bare sense of being yourself. Where is it? What is it like?
Welcome to Schumann mode 5, 33.8 hertz: the fifth harmonic, at the edge of gamma. Sit comfortably and stay softly alert. After this minute, the beat glides into place and holds.

Welcome to tattva vision. Sit upright in a softly lit room. Press Tattva card, choose an element, and follow the gaze timer: look at the dot in the centre of the symbol, steadily, for about twenty seconds.

Let a wave of relaxation begin at the top of your head. Let it flow down through your face, your jaw, your neck and shoulders, down your arms to your fingertips, through your chest and back, and down through your legs to the soles of your feet.
Keep rising, through layers of colour, until you come into a warm golden light, like a sun at the centre of everything. Rest here, and feel it in your chest.
Welcome to the swing technique. Wear headphones, lie back, and close your eyes. The tone will sway gently from ear to ear, like a swing moving back and forth. Let your body grow heavy.
Tune in to theta, 5.5 hertz, popularly linked to inner guidance. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 5.5 hertz and holds there.

Welcome to the hypnagogic light journey. Lie back with your eyes closed and your face toward the light, in a dark room. Start the light journey now. Flicker alternates with a soft steady glow, guiding you toward the dreamy edge of sleep.

Welcome to Gamma. Sit comfortably with your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. In a few minutes the beat rises to forty hertz, a bright, fast rhythm studied for creative thinking. Stay relaxed and alert.
Welcome to Alpha Calm. Sit or lie back and let your eyes close. Let your breathing slow a little, and let your shoulders drop. The beat will ease you into the relaxed alpha rhythm of ten hertz.
Breathe in as the bell sounds. On the long breath out, chant Om aloud, feeling the vibration in your chest and head.
A soft, steady glow now. Let the images linger and drift.
Tune in to delta, three hertz: the deep sleep rhythm studied in the lab. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 3 hertz and holds there.
Tune in to gamma, forty five hertz, just above the classic forty. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 45 hertz and holds there.
Begin to hum along with the drone, softly. Let the hum move up and down as it likes.
Rest your attention lightly at the space between your eyebrows.
A one minute practice block at ten hertz, so you know what to expect. Just observe.
The flicker begins. Keep your eyes closed, relax, and simply observe whatever colours, patterns or images appear.
Let the happiness settle further, into deep, calm contentment, peaceful and still.
The light begins. Breathe slowly, and let the colours open up.
Now fall silent. Listen inwardly. Rest in the closeness that the words have opened.
Keep your attention on the touch of the breath at your nostrils, breath after breath. When the mind wanders, come back. Let concentration deepen until the breath is easy to follow.
Drift back down into your body. Feel its weight and warmth. Slowly open your eyes, turn off the light, and take a moment to recall what you experienced.
Go wherever you are drawn: over hills, rivers or cities. Notice what you see from above and up close. If you find a place that feels powerful, rest there for a while.
Five hertz.
Tune in to alpha, 8.5 hertz: relaxed awareness. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 8.5 hertz and holds there.
Imagine a rope hanging above you. Reach up with imagined hands and climb, hand over hand.
Welcome to the tone of Venus, 221.23 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to the tone of Pluto, 140.25 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to the Jesus Prayer. Sit still, with your head slightly bowed and your eyes closed. Bring your attention down from your head into your heart. The bell will mark each slow breath.
Welcome to the root chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at the base of your spine.
Notice that there is no line where awareness ends and its contents begin. Sounds, thoughts and sensations are like waves in the same water. Rest, without effort.
Welcome to the humming bee breath. Sit comfortably with your eyes closed. Press Breathwork to start the guide. On each long breath out, hum softly, and feel the vibration in your face and head.
Let yourself drift toward sleep, holding the intention lightly.
Now rise up, above the roof of your house. Look down at the roof, the street and the gardens around it. Rise higher, until you see the whole neighbourhood.
Fly wherever you wish. When you are ready, come down and land somewhere new. Look at your feet. What are you wearing? Look around, and explore.

Tune in to epsilon, half a hertz, below delta: a rhythm some link to very deep meditation. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 0.5 hertz and holds there.
Three hertz, irregular.
Nine hertz.
Let yourself drift.
The drum calls you back. Return the way you came.
The flicker begins at nine hertz. Let the colours wash over you.
Eleven hertz.
Welcome to Beta Focus. Sit upright and open the task you are about to work on. Put your phone out of reach. In three minutes the beat rises to sixteen hertz to help you stay alert.
Tune in to SMR, thirteen hertz: calm, steady focus. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 13 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to Deep Sleep. Lie down in bed, turn the volume very low, and let the day go. Over the next half hour the beat slows toward three hertz as you drift into sleep.
Tune in to delta, 1.5 hertz: restorative sleep, and Monroe's body layer. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 1.5 hertz and holds there.
Now let it rest in the light above, and dissolve, open and spacious. Rest in that openness for a while.
Facilitating change.
Now whisper the prayer, keeping the same slow rhythm with the breath and the bell.
From up here, look down. See your body resting peacefully below you. Notice the room from this new viewpoint: the light, the shapes, the colours. Everything is calm.
Welcome to coherent breathing. Sit or lie comfortably, and let your belly soften. Press Breathwork to start the guide: six seconds in, six seconds out, smooth and silent, five breaths a minute.
Time to wake. Stretch, breathe deeply, and open your eyes.
Drift toward sleep while keeping the problem loosely in mind. If the object drops, gently return.
Welcome to the senses technique. You have just woken after about five hours of sleep and been up for a few minutes. Lie down comfortably, close your eyes, and keep the volume very low.
Ahead of you, someone is waiting: a wise and kind presence. It may be a person, an animal, or a light. Let it appear in its own way, and greet it.
Silently introduce your sacred word, gently, like a feather on cotton. You do not need to repeat it; let it simply be there.
If an energetic joy, rapture, begins to rise and spread, let it fill you. Don't grab it; just stay with it.
Imagine that your legs are stretching out through the soles of your feet, a few centimetres longer than they really are. Feel it. Then let them return to normal.
Let the circling slow and stop. Gather all the warmth back into the point below your navel, and rest your hands there for a moment.
Welcome to the tone of the Earth day, 194.18 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Imagine yourself on a path in a beautiful, peaceful place. Notice the ground under your feet, the sounds, the smells. Follow the path, slowly.
Rest here. There is nothing you need to do. Just listen.
Slower still. Let shapes turn into scenes, and follow them.
Welcome to concert pitch, 440 hertz, the international tuning standard. Sit back and close your eyes, and use it as a comparison for 432. An eight hertz alpha beat rides on the tone.
Tune in to beta, twenty hertz: energy and arousal. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 20 hertz and holds there.
This is the phase technique. Use it right after waking, ideally after about six hours of sleep. Do not move, and do not open your eyes. Stay still, relaxed and quiet, with the volume very low.
Welcome to the middle world journey. Lie down and cover your eyes. Picture a place in nature that you know well, real and alive. Set your intention to travel out from there, across the land.

Welcome to bhastrika, the bellows breath. Sit upright, with your spine tall and your shoulders relaxed. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Breathe in and out forcefully through the nose, like a bellows, driven by the belly.

Welcome to the original Ganzflicker. Unlike the other light journeys, this one is done with your eyes open. Dim the room, sit at arm's length from the screen, and start the light journey. It stays dark for one minute.
Welcome to the imagery descent. Close your eyes and face the light. The journey begins with bright ten hertz patterns, then slows toward theta, where scenes can become soft and dreamlike.
Tune in to delta, 2.5 hertz, a rate popularly linked to easing pain. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 2.5 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to Solfeggio 396 hertz, traditionally linked to releasing fear and guilt. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.

Cycle quickly through your senses, two or three seconds each. Sight: the darkness behind your eyelids. Sound: whatever you can hear. Body: the feel of the bed. Then begin again, sight, sound, body, around and around.
Now listen for the subtlest part of each sound: the shimmer at its edge, the long, quiet tail as it dies away.
Choose a short phrase: a prayer, a mantra, or a single word like peace. Breathe in as the bell sounds, then silently recite your phrase slowly through the whole breath out.
Now, with the next breath out, let your awareness gently float up, out of your body, rising slowly toward the ceiling. Easily and safely, you are floating above your body.

Welcome to the Bartossek three hertz protocol, the slow flicker condition. Close your eyes in a dark room, facing the light. Start the light journey now: it stays dark for one minute, then flashes three times a second for twenty minutes.
Welcome to Focus 10, mind awake, body asleep. Lie back and loosen anything tight. Let your eyes close. Your body will drift toward sleep while your mind stays clear, so let the tones do the work.
Good morning. Take a deep breath and stretch.
Awareness without effort. Rest.
Eight hertz, irregular.
Connection, relationships.
Notice the gentle pulse within the sound. Let your attention rest on it, relaxed and awake.

Welcome to the Amaya frequency and rhythm series. Close your eyes and face the light, and start the light journey now. You will get two minute blocks at ten, eight and three hertz, each rhythmic then irregular, with short dark pauses between them.
Welcome to the tone of Jupiter, 183.58 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.

This is phase technique cycling, for the first moments after waking. Don't move, and keep your eyes closed. When you hear each technique, try it for a few seconds, then switch when the next one comes.
The rhythm lifts again, bright and clear.
At the bottom of the stairs is a place of complete peace, real or imagined. Notice what you see, the sounds around you, the temperature of the air. You are safe here.
Rotation. Imagine your body turning around its long axis, like a log in water.
Listen to the rain. Let your thoughts drift like the sound of falling water.
Lie still for a few moments with your eyes closed. What would you like to remember from this? When you are ready, sit up slowly, and write it down.
Look away from the mirror, and turn up the lights. Feel your feet on the floor. Take a few deep breaths, and be gentle with yourself for the rest of the day.
Welcome to nada yoga. Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and let the sound of the bowls fill the space around you. Listen to each tone from the moment it is struck until it fades.
Imagine a staircase with ten steps. With each step down, you go twice as deep into calm. Ten. Nine. Eight. Seven. Six. Five. Four. Three. Two. One. Deeply relaxed.
Tune in to high beta, thirty hertz: strong stimulation, best used sparingly. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 30 hertz and holds there.
Listening in. Listen for any noise inside your head, and try to make it louder.
Tune in to gamma, thirty five hertz, in low gamma. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 35 hertz and holds there.
At your heart, see a small, bright sphere of light, your own awareness. With each breath out, let it rise gently up the channel toward the light above, and settle back to the heart as you breathe in.
When you notice you have drifted into thoughts, gently come back to the sound. There is no right or wrong; even the drifting is part of it.
Get comfortable and let yourself fall asleep. The soft pulses will begin later, once you are asleep.
Let the words become fewer, until only the sense of prayer remains, resting in the heart, in stillness.
Begin to return. Slowly count from one to five. Feel your body, the surface beneath you, and the room around you. When you are ready, open your eyes, awake and refreshed.
Flicker again, a little slower, at eight hertz.
Open the hum into vowels: ah, oh, ee. Sing freely around the drone, with no tune you have to follow.
Four hertz.
Finish with loving kindness. Let goodwill flow from you to all beings: may all beings be happy, may all beings be peaceful.
Seven hertz.
Return to a whisper.
Crown, oneness.
Let the floating body sink gently back down and merge with your physical body. Feel your whole weight again.
Let go of time. There is no before and after here, only this vast, open now.
Without moving your physical body, imagine gently rolling sideways, as if turning over in bed, and floating up and away.
Love frequency, transformation.
Tune in to alpha, ten hertz: the classic relaxed alpha peak. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 10 hertz and holds there.
Again, when you hear the chime, become aware. Notice that you are aware. Imagine noticing the chime inside a dream, and realising: this is a dream.
Twelve hertz: the fastest rate here.
Now shift your attention to a pleasant sensation somewhere in the body: perhaps in your hands, your chest, or a gentle smile. Rest on it, and let it grow by itself.
Tune in to beta, twenty four hertz, used in early vigilance research. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 24 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to the tone of Neptune, 211.44 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to Visualisation. Sit or lie back and close your eyes. Bring to mind one goal that matters to you, and hold it loosely for now. In a few minutes you will picture it in rich detail.
Welcome to vipassana. Sit with your back straight and your eyes closed, and resolve to stay still for this sitting. Bring your attention to the area below your nostrils, above your upper lip.
Imagine energy rising from the top of your head like a fountain, flowing down around you, and forming a protective balloon that surrounds your whole body.
Let the sound go. Sit with your eyes closed for two more minutes, without the mantra, before slowly opening your eyes.
Welcome to the solar plexus chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at just above your navel.
Welcome to Solfeggio 963 hertz, traditionally linked to the crown, and oneness. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Picture your own body lying here, as if seen from the foot of the bed. Notice your clothes, your hands, the shape of your face, the way you are lying.
Begin to think the sound quietly, without moving your lips. Don't force it or concentrate on it. Let it come and go, as faint as it likes.
Feel energy rising through your body.
Welcome to Anxiety Ease. You are safe, and there is nothing to fix right now. Breathe in for five seconds, and out for five. Let the slow rhythm of your breath do the calming.

Welcome to the microcosmic orbit. Sit upright on the front of a chair, with your feet flat and your hands resting in your lap. Close your eyes, and touch the tip of your tongue lightly to the roof of your mouth.
You are in the upper world. Notice the light, the colours, the ground beneath you. Ask to meet your teacher, and see who comes. Ask your question, and listen.
Welcome to Focus 22, the dreamlike edge. Lie back and let your eyes close. We travel through the familiar Focus levels first, then rest where waking and dreaming overlap. Let images come and go.
Welcome to hitbodedut. Find a place where you can be alone, outdoors if possible, or simply a quiet room. Sit, or walk slowly. You will speak in your own words, as to a close and loving friend.
Observing images. Look into the darkness in front of your closed eyes, and watch for any picture.
Ten hertz, irregular. The same average speed, but uneven. Notice the difference.
Welcome back to bed. You have been up for a little while; now lie down comfortably. Each time you hear the chime, repeat silently: next time I am dreaming, I will remember that I am dreaming.
Slowly, the sense of your body returns: its weight, the surface under you, the air on your skin. Take your time. Breathe deeper, stretch, and open your eyes when you are ready.

Welcome to dhikr, the remembrance of God. Sit cross legged or on a chair, with your back upright and your eyes closed. Place your attention at your heart. When the bell begins, let each ring mark one repetition of your phrase.
Welcome to the tone of the Sun, 126.22 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.

Welcome to Solfeggio 639 hertz, traditionally linked to connection and relationships. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Let even the water disappear. There is only darkness, stillness and breath. Rest here. Nothing to do, nowhere to be.
Simply observe. Let colours, shapes and images arise on their own, without trying to hold on to them.
Slower still, seven hertz. Let yourself drift toward dreaming.
Notice the edges of your body softening, and the sense of being separate fading. Imagine everything as one whole, including you.
Turn back to the doorway, and step through it again. See it shrink back to a small symbol, and fade. Feel your body, take a deep breath, and open your eyes.
Rest at the soft edge of dreaming. Images may come and go. Let them pass like clouds.
The steady light is on. Keep your eyes closed, and simply observe what you see, with no flicker at all.
Tune in to beta, sixteen hertz: vigilance. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 16 hertz and holds there.
Feel that weightless body slowly rotating, turning along its length like a log in water, around and around, while your physical body stays still.
Feel your connection to the ground beneath you, stable and safe.
Slow flicker begins. Keep your eyes closed and observe. Notice how slow flashes look different from fast ones.
Bring your attention to your throat. Imagine a soft, glowing red light there, warm and clear, like a small flame. Rest your awareness in it, gently.

Welcome to slow pace bhastrika. Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed. Press Breathwork to start the guide: a deep, full breath in for four seconds, and a deep breath out for six, through both nostrils.
Let your forehead, jaw and neck soften with each breath.
Sleep.
In a moment, count with me from one to five. One, energy returning. Two, aware of your body. Three, breathing deeper. Four, ready to open your eyes. Five, eyes open, wide awake and refreshed.
Tune in to alpha, twelve hertz: centred and mentally steady. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 12 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to effortless mantra meditation. Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and rest for a moment. Choose a soft, pleasant sound with no meaning for you, such as ah hum.
Rest your attention between your eyebrows.

Welcome to rising on the planes. Sit upright or lie flat, and close your eyes. Breathe slowly and deeply. Imagine a column of soft light running straight up through your body, from below your feet to far above your head.
Expression, problem solving.
Breathe in slowly and deeply. As you breathe out, hum gently, and feel the vibration in your chest and head. Let your hum blend with the tones.
Let the light come down and dissolve into you, filling your body with warmth. Seal the channel at the crown, feel your body, and open your eyes slowly.
Try to separate straight away: roll out sideways, or float up, without moving your physical body.
Choose a spot slightly above eye level and rest your gaze on it. As you watch it, your eyelids begin to feel heavier. When they want to close, let them close.
Now move back up, from the toes to the top of the head, part by part, with the same calm, balanced attention. Every sensation arises, and passes away.
This is the layered beats demo, in the Hemi-Sync style. Three pairs of tones play at once, each with its own beat. Close your eyes and listen to the chord of rhythms settle into one.
Tune in to low beta, fifteen hertz: active thinking. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 15 hertz and holds there.

Now move your attention part by part, from the top of your head down to your toes, observing whatever sensation you find: warmth, tingling, pressure, or nothing at all. Observe without craving or aversion.

Welcome to kapalabhati, the skull shining breath. Sit upright with your hands on your knees. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Each breath out is a short, sharp push from the belly; each breath in happens by itself.
Chant aloud once more.
Welcome to self inquiry. Sit quietly, with your eyes closed. Let the body settle, and the breath find its own rhythm. Notice the simple feeling of being here: I am.
Welcome to Focus 3, the first step. Lie back or sit comfortably, let your eyes close, and simply listen as the three layers of tone begin to blend into one.
Repeat your intention once more, then gently return.
Imagine an opening in the earth, and travel through it to a peaceful landscape.
Now turn your listening inward. In the silence you may notice a faint inner sound: a hum, a hiss, a ringing, or a soft roar. Rest your attention on it gently, and let it draw you inward.

Tune in to gamma, forty hertz: the most studied gamma rhythm, linked to perceptual binding. Sit comfortably, with your eyes closed or softly open. After this minute, the beat glides to 40 hertz and holds there.
Now let the warmth flow down to the base of your body, then slowly up along your spine, between your shoulder blades, up the back of your neck to the crown of your head.
Let ideas come without judging them.
Return now, and write down whatever came to you.
Let counting fall away. Just sit.
The flicker has stopped. Close your eyes, rest, and take a moment to recall what you saw.
Tune in to alpha, 10.5 hertz, popularly linked to mind and body healing. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 10.5 hertz and holds there.
This is the coloured noise demo: no tones and no beats, just steady pink noise. Use it to compare how you feel with and without beats. Close your eyes and rest in the soft rush of sound.
Welcome to the tone of the Moon, 210.42 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Tune in to alpha, eleven hertz: relaxed alertness. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 11 hertz and holds there.
Now notice the awareness in which all of this appears. Rest as that, the knowing itself, rather than any thing that is known.
Look at the photographs and keepsakes, one by one. Remember the times you shared: their voice, their laugh, the things they said. Let any feelings come, and let them be.
Welcome to the heart chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at the centre of your chest.
Welcome to the Power Nap. Lie down, close your eyes, and let your body grow heavy. You will rest for about ten minutes, then the beat brings you gently back up, awake and refreshed.
Imagine you are floating on warm, still water at exactly the temperature of your skin. Feel the water hold you completely. You don't need to hold yourself up at all.
Recite the phrase aloud with each bell: la ilaha illallah, there is no god but God. On the first half, turn your head gently to the right; on the second, bring it down toward your heart.
Now simply rest in the even glow and the steady sound. Let your senses go quiet. Notice any images or sensations, without holding on to them.
Imagine that you are slowly rising out of your body, light and free, and drifting up toward the ceiling. Look around the room from above, and notice everything you can.
Now let it roll, swing, or drift sideways through the air above you. Notice that you can feel both at once: the floating body moving, and the physical body still.
Alert, clear and ready.
Let the imagined viewpoint rise slowly upward, until it is near the ceiling, looking straight down at your body below.
If the sensations feel subtle and flowing, let your attention sweep through the whole body in one smooth movement, up and down.
Three hertz: slow, distinct flashes.
Seven and a half hertz, at the edge of theta. Deeply relaxed, calm and still.
This is the descending carriers demo. Layered beats sink in stages, from alpha down to delta, over half an hour. Lie back, close your eyes, and let each step take you a little deeper.

Welcome to rebirthing breath. Lie down on a soft surface, somewhere safe, and loosen tight clothing. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Draw each breath in, and simply let it go, with no pause in between.
This is the bilateral tones demo. Wear headphones. The tone moves from your left ear to your right and back, about once a second. Close your eyes and let your attention follow it, side to side.

Welcome to power breathing. Sit or lie down somewhere safe, never in or near water. When you are ready, press Breathwork and start the guide. Begin with a few calm breaths, and never force a breath hold.
Six hertz. Float in whatever appears.
The flicker begins. With your eyes open, rest your gaze softly on the centre of the screen. Let your eyes relax, and watch what appears.
Mind awake, body asleep. Let your body drift toward sleep while your awareness stays clear and alert, simply observing.
Let yourself sink into the sound. Release any effort to control what happens. Like a leaf on a river, let yourself be carried.
This is the isochronic tones demo: one tone switching cleanly on and off, six times a second. Speakers are fine. Close your eyes and let the even pulse hold your attention.
Now join it to the breath. Breathing in, the energy rises up the spine. Breathing out, it flows down the front. Circle after circle, smooth and unhurried.
Ten hertz, the alpha peak. For most people, the strongest patterns.
Feel your body lying completely still: the weight of your head, your back against the surface, your heels. Know that your body will stay right here, safe and motionless.
Slowly open your eyes. Take a moment to recall what you saw.
When the symbol disappears, keep looking at the plain screen, and watch the afterimage glow in the opposite colour. Then close your eyes, and hold that image in your mind.
This is the rhythmic drumming demo, the oldest sound system of all. No tones, only the drum. Close your eyes, and let its steady beat, about four times a second, carry your attention inward.
Thank your guide, and know you can return. Walk back along the path, feel your body again, and open your eyes when you are ready.
Each time you hear this chime, pause and ask yourself: am I dreaming? Look at your hands, notice your breathing, and look around with curiosity.
This is the binaural beats demo. Wear stereo headphones: each ear hears a slightly different tone, and your brain creates the slow six hertz wobble. Close your eyes and listen for it.
Welcome. This session calms you before you try to leave the body. Wear headphones. Lie back, close your eyes, and let the tone sway gently from ear to ear. With each sway, let a little fear go.
Follow the circle. Breathe in as it grows, and out as it shrinks.
Relax your throat and jaw. Let your voice feel free.
Notice a pleasant lightness spreading through you. Your body rests heavy and safe, while your awareness feels lighter and lighter, as light as a feather.
Phantom wiggling. Imagine moving your hand back and forth, without any real movement.
Follow whatever images or ideas arise.

Welcome to cyclic hyperventilation, the Stanford five minute protocol. Sit or lie somewhere safe, away from water. Press Breathwork to start the guide: thirty deep breaths, then a fifteen second hold with empty lungs, three times.
Close your eyes. Let the steady drum carry your attention.
Welcome to free vocalisation. Sit or stand somewhere you can make sound freely, without being overheard if that helps. Close your eyes, relax your jaw, and take a few deep breaths.
Let the recitation become softer, a murmur, still one phrase with each bell, the movement smaller.
Now chant silently, in your mind only, still moving your fingers with the bell.
Feel open space above the top of your head.
Whenever a thought arises, ask: to whom does this thought arise? To me. Then ask: who am I? Don't answer with words. Turn back to the feeling of I itself.

Welcome to the frequency scan. Close your eyes, face the light, and start the light journey now. The flicker begins at three hertz and steps up by one hertz each minute, to twelve. Notice how the patterns change with the speed.
Tune in to gamma, fifty hertz, played as quick isochronic pulses. Keep the volume comfortable and low. After this minute, the beat glides to 50 hertz and holds there.

Welcome to connected breathing. Lie down on a soft surface somewhere safe, never in water. Press Breathwork to start the guide. Breathe fully, with no pause between in and out, and slow down if tingling gets strong.
Now whisper the sounds, keeping the finger movements going.
This is a session of self hypnosis for deep relaxation. You remain in control throughout, and you can open your eyes and return at any time, simply by choosing to.
Now feel a sense of lifting, as if a second, weightless body is rising a hand's width above the first. Don't picture it; feel it, the way you feel your hand without looking.
The rhythm slows. Let the patterns grow and change.
Now set the keepsakes aside, and gaze softly into the depth of the mirror. Don't strain or expect anything. Just keep gazing, relaxed and open, with the person in your heart.
Whatever you experienced, or did not, take a moment to say what you would like to say to them, aloud or silently. Thank them.
Now let even the question rest. Stay as the quiet sense of being, before any thought. If thoughts return, ask again, and come back.
Now drift slowly back down, and settle gently into your body, fitting it perfectly, like a hand into a glove. Feel its weight, and your breathing.
Welcome to Study and Memory. Open your book or notes, and clear your desk of distractions. Sit upright and take three slow breaths. Then begin reading, and let the steady tone hold your focus.
Nothing to do. Just rest.
Welcome to the full Solfeggio journey: nine tones, three minutes each, rising from 174 to 963 hertz. Close your eyes. We begin at 174 hertz, the tone of foundation and grounding.
This is the spatial audio demo. Wear headphones. The tone drifts slowly from side to side around your head, about once every ten seconds. Close your eyes and follow it as it travels.
Tune in to alpha, nine hertz: calm body awareness. Close your eyes and let your shoulders soften. After this minute, the beat glides to 9 hertz and holds there.
Keep speaking from the heart: your thanks, your worries, your hopes, your regrets. There is no wrong thing to say. Let it all come out.
Steady glow again. Notice what remains when the flashing stops.
Tune in to lambda, two hundred hertz, a speculative band from popular sources. Keep the volume comfortable and low. After this minute, the beat glides to 200 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to the tone of Uranus, 207.36 hertz, from Hans Cousto's cosmic octave. Lie back and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a six hertz theta beat begins.
Welcome to Solfeggio 417 hertz, traditionally linked to facilitating change. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
The rhythm slows gently toward eight hertz. Let your body grow heavier as it slows.
Imagine that you are standing outside your own front door. Notice the door, the ground under your feet, the light, the weather. Look down at your feet.
Welcome to Theta Meditation. Sit comfortably, eyes closed, and let your attention rest on your breathing. Over the next minutes the beat slows toward six hertz, the rhythm of deep meditation.
Welcome to Alpha Theta training. Sit back and let your eyes close. For the first part, simply rest in calm alpha. Later the beat slips toward the border of theta, where dreamlike images begin.

Welcome to the Bartossek ten hertz protocol. Lie back or sit facing the light in a dark room, and close your eyes. Press Light journey and start it now: the light stays off during this first minute, then flickers for twenty minutes.
Bring warmth and gentle flow to your lower belly.
Welcome to the theta gamma stack. Lie back and let your eyes close. Two beats play together: a slow theta beat for depth, and a quiet forty hertz beat for clarity. Let your breathing slow.
Welcome to Schumann mode 4, 27.3 hertz: the fourth harmonic, high in the beta range. Sit comfortably and stay softly alert. After this minute, the beat glides into place and holds.
On each breath out, chant or silently hear the sound Om, matched to the tone.

Welcome to the upper world journey. Lie down and cover your eyes. Choose a way up that you know, perhaps a tall tree, a ladder, or rising smoke. Set your intention: to meet a teacher who can help you.

Welcome to centering prayer. Sit comfortably, with your back upright and your eyes closed. Choose a sacred word, such as God, Jesus, Abba, peace or love, as a symbol of your intention to rest in God's presence.
Welcome to grounding, for after any deep practice. Sit up slowly. Place both feet flat on the floor, and press them down. Feel how solid the floor is, and how awake your body is becoming.
Welcome to the sacral chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at your lower belly.
Now imagine stretching out through the top of your head, a few centimetres taller. Feel it, then return. Now alternate: longer through the feet, then taller through the head.
Look back over your day, and see it as if it had been a dream: the places, the people, the feelings, all appearing and passing, vivid but insubstantial.

Welcome to the Dreamachine wander. Sit with your eyes closed and your face close to the warm light, as Gysin's guests once sat by the spinning cylinder. The rhythm drifts between eight and twelve hertz.
Welcome to scientific pitch, with middle C at 256 hertz. Sit back and close your eyes. A ten hertz alpha beat rides on the tone. Simply rest, and listen.
Chant aloud with the bell, one syllable per note. Saa. Taa. Naa. Maa. Touch your thumb to each fingertip in turn: index, middle, ring, little finger.
Now pray silently, in the heart, with each breath in and each breath out. When your mind wanders, gently return to the words.
Welcome to floating. Wear headphones and keep the volume low. Lie back, close your eyes, and let your body grow heavy. Soon the sound begins to drift slowly around your head.
Notice any tingling, buzzing or waves of sensation. Let them grow without fear. They are a normal part of deep relaxation.
Three hertz, rhythmic. Slow, distinct flashes.
Now let the sounds become syllables, flowing on their own, without meaning or plan. Don't judge them; let your voice lead, and simply follow it.
Begin to shape what you found.
Tune in to theta, seven hertz: mental imagery and visualisation. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow. After this minute, the beat glides to 7 hertz and holds there.
Welcome to Solfeggio 285 hertz, traditionally linked to restoration. Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Let your breathing slow; in two minutes a gentle six hertz theta beat begins.
Tune in to beta, eighteen hertz: alertness and engagement. Sit upright, comfortable and alert. After this minute, the beat glides to 18 hertz and holds there.
Tune in to delta, two hertz: deep sleep and detachment. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 2 hertz and holds there.
Imagine a peaceful place of your own creation: a garden, a shore, a meadow. Rest there in complete safety.

Welcome to the sweet spot sweep. Close your eyes and face the light. The flicker starts at eight hertz and climbs one step every two minutes. Notice which speed gives you the brightest colours and patterns.
Welcome to the throat chakra meditation. Sit with your spine tall and your eyes closed, and let your breathing slow. Soon your attention will rest at your throat.
Move your attention slowly through your body: right hand, arm, shoulder, left hand, arm, shoulder, down through your torso, legs and feet.

Welcome to the kaleidoscope. Close your eyes and face the light. At twelve hertz, the fastest rate here, look for crisp shapes: checkerboards, spirals, honeycombs, and lines radiating from the centre.
Tune in to delta, 3.5 hertz, popularly linked to receptivity and unity. Lie down, keep the volume low, and let your body grow heavy. After this minute, the beat glides to 3.5 hertz and holds there.
Notice your beliefs as if from a distance, with curiosity rather than judgement.
Pause. The light is off. Keep your eyes closed, and rate how strong the visuals were, from zero to ten.
Rest now in equanimity: neither pleasant nor unpleasant, completely still, clear and balanced.

Welcome to the ghost frequency. Keep the volume low. If you wish, press Infrasound and accept the warning to add the 18.98 hertz layer. Sit in a dim room, close your eyes, and notice how you feel, without expectation.
Pray aloud, slowly, with each breath. Breathing in: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God. Breathing out: have mercy on me.
Relaxed, calm awareness.
Ten hertz, rhythmic. Watch the patterns.
Body: feel your weight, the bed, and any tingling or heaviness.
Gently press your thumb and forefinger together. From now on, this simple touch can bring back this feeling of calm whenever you need it.

Welcome to the phone light journey. On a phone, choose the flashlight in the light panel, and hold it ten to twenty centimetres from your closed eyes. On a computer, face the screen. Start the light journey when you are ready.
Picture yourself standing in a familiar room. Notice the light, the textures, the sounds and the smell of the place, in rich detail.
Welcome to the laboratory out of body induction. Dim the room, turn on the Ganzfeld light, and lie or sit back facing the soft red glow. Close your eyes. The steady noise is part of the method.
